title: Potential NVIDIA Deal Speculation Puts Spotlight On Dell Valuation And Momentum
title_zh: NVIDIA 潜在交易猜测让戴尔估值和势头成为焦点
summary: Reports suggest NVIDIA is exploring a large acquisition in the PC space, with market speculation focusing on Dell Technologies (NYSE:DELL) as a possible target.
summary_zh: 有报道称，NVIDIA 正在探索 PC 领域的大规模收购，市场猜测戴尔科技公司 (NYSE:DELL) 可能是一个可能的收购目标。

title: Bitcoin Climbs to Two-Month High Amid Middle East Deal Optimism
title_zh: 在中东交易乐观情绪中，比特币攀升至两个月高位
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Bitcoin rose to the highest level since early February after a flurry of comments from the US and Iran sparked optimism that the conflict in the Middle East may be heading toward a resolution.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国和伊朗的一系列言论引发了人们对中东冲突可能走向解决的乐观情绪，比特币升至 2 月初以来的最高水平。
